milestoneText: Final milestone: stateful escrow with transferable CashToken role badges.
fundingRequirement: The mint funding UTXO must spend output index 0 of its transaction. Set tokenCategory to that outpoint transaction ID. A matching txid at index 1 is not a valid CashTokens genesis category.

lockVariables.tokenCategory: <the 64-hex txid of the index-0 funding UTXO used for mint>

partialRelease.currentEscrowSatoshis: <value of the escrow input before this payout>

followUpVariables.recipientLockingScript: <locking script hex that receives a transferred badge>

actions: mint - create the one-time minting NFT
lock - burn minting NFT, create escrow and badges
release - client badge: SUBMITTED -> RELEASED, pay developer
partialRelease - client badge: pay part now, keep rest in escrow
resolveToDeveloper - arbiter badge: SUBMITTED -> RELEASED, pay developer
refund - client badge + deadline: FUNDED/SUBMITTED -> REFUNDED
arbiterRefund - arbiter badge + deadline: FUNDED/SUBMITTED -> REFUNDED
instructions: Open this invitation in Blaze on Chipnet and accept it as the client role.
Fund the wallet with about 0.011 BCH. The funding UTXO must be outpoint index 0.
Set tokenCategory to that index-0 funding txid and execute mint.
After mint confirms, select the minting NFT and run lock. Enter lockedSatoshis=1000000, refundDeadline, milestoneHash, and the same tokenCategory.
The lock transaction creates the escrow output, three distinct badge addresses, and the milestone OP_RETURN.
Follow-ups are exposed on the escrow UTXO and on each badge UTXO in Blaze.
All follow-ups are also available to the client role in this single-wallet demo.
For partialRelease enter currentEscrowSatoshis, payoutNow, and remainingSatoshis so that payoutNow + remainingSatoshis = currentEscrowSatoshis.
Export RAW executed invitations from Blaze (Save/Copy invitation), not the display JSON with placeholders.
note: Open mint invitation only. The user-written 500-word developer feedback is a separate submission artifact.
